name: GPT-6 Sol
archDisplay: Proprietary model; architecture and parameter count undisclosed; 1.05M-token context, selectable reasoning effort (none to max)
note: API id gpt-6-sol, released 2026-09-22 together with GPT-6 Luna as cheaper GPT-6-generation tiers 'trained with similar methods as GPT-6 Astra'. It costs $2/$10 per Mtok, 50% below GPT-5.6 Sol's promotional $4/$20. It has a 1.05M context and 128K max output. It launched in ChatGPT Work/Codex and the API, and on 2026-10-07 became the default GPT-6 in ChatGPT for paid tiers. GPT-6.1 Sol superseded it in the API on 2026-09-29. On 2026-09-25 OpenAI fixed an image-encoding bug that had degraded GPT-6 Sol/Luna image understanding, so vision-dependent launch-week third-party scores may understate it. Most launch claims are cost-relative charts; only the four numeric figures below were printed.

results.notes: AutomationBench 1.0.6 at XHIGH effort, from the launch table. GPT-6 Astra (low) 30.3, Claude Opus 5 (max) 26.9, Claude Fable 5.1 w/ Opus 5 fallback (max) 31.4. Cost $0.27/task.
DeepSWE v1.1 at MAX effort; 'within 1.1 percentage points of Claude Fable 5's highest score... 69.9% at xhigh'.
OSWorld 2.0 OFFLINE set, partial reward, v2026.08.08 release, at XHIGH effort; Claude Opus 5 (medium) 60.3. Partial reward matches the corpus convention, but it is the offline set only.
Public ExploitBench at maximum effort, as a comparison figure in the GPT-6.1 Sol system card addendum (§9.1.2.1). OpenAI caveat: 'results may be artificially inflated due to potential contamination'.

FrontierCode 1.1 (Main), GPT-6 Sol column of Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 launch table (competitor-table figure, per the corpus precedent of filing rival launch tables). OpenAI's own page only says it 'is able to match Claude Fable 5.1 xhigh'.
